description: Add a wallet to your watchlist with a private name ("Treasury", "Dev wallet of XYZ"), or rename one already on it. Labels are private to your agent key. Then watched_events tells you what your wallets did since you last checked. Paid: needs an agent key from https://fivebar.xyz/x402/watch/watch10 ($5, 10 wallets, 30 days) or watch50 ($20, 50 wallets), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

chains.description: Chains to watch it on, default all: robinhood,base,ethereum,arbitrum,hyperevm,elysium

label.description: A private name for it, up to 60 characters
